limitations: Correlation between PROGENy and CytoSig pathway/cytokine activity scores reflects statistical co-variation across baseline transcriptomes and does not establish mechanistic or causal directionality between cytokine exposure and downstream pathway activation.
Both PROGENy and CytoSig scores are computationally inferred relative footprint z-scores, not direct biochemical concentrations or absolute quantification of ligand/signaling molecules.
Patient-level metadata were not exported; only cell-line level primary disease annotations from rna_cell_lines were analyzed.
